title: Chili Crunch Chicken Tenders

ingredients.item: 2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or tenderloins)
2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp paprika

steps: Season. Cut the chicken into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long; season on all sides.
Set up. One bowl with flour, cornstarch and baking powder; another with the whisked eggs.
Heat oil. Heat 2–3 inches of oil to 350 °F / 175 °C.
Coat. Drizzle a spoonful of egg into the flour and toss to make crispy bits. Dip each tender in egg, let it drip, then press into the flour and shake off the excess.
Fry. Fry in batches without touching for 1–2 minutes, then 7–10 minutes total until golden and cooked. Drain on a rack and salt.
Mayo. Mix mayonnaise and chili crunch until smooth.
Serve. Pile on a plate with fries or rice, drizzle with chili crunch, scatter green onions and serve with the mayo.
